title: A stale eval record names the units that moved, not just two aggregates
deviations_from_card: None in scope. Acceptance 7's second half is pinned as a unit test (intake_eval.main --no-llm --strict with check_dialog patched so one persona loses 'turn_budget' and another gains 'turn_budget_renamed', net n unchanged: exit 1, finding names 'left: power_unit_backfill/turn_budget' and 'joined: power_unit_scaling/turn_budget_renamed', no 'corpus size moved'), instead of editing intake_scenarios.json; a pure rename alone would move no n, so loss+gain is the n-neutral shape. settle_live/certify_live/record_measurements now take the live units as a required argument (certify_live(live, units, *, bars=None, recorded=None)); existing tests updated to pass them. fault CertifiedDrillSizeTest no longer mocks _aggregate: it rebuilds rows from the committed unit ids.
notes: measurements.units.json bootstrapped once (placeholder ids with the recorded n, then each eval's --record replaced them); all six deterministic figures unchanged (1.0/1.0/0.857 over 7/4/7, 1.0/42, 1.0/240, 1.0/98), measured_at re-dated 2026-09-23 -> 2026-09-24 because the record now carries units. Recorded on a tree carrying sibling uncommitted edits to pipeline/jobfit/matching.py (additive include_blocked, default off) and automation.py (comment only); neither can move a unit, and test:eval:ci was green after. tsc exit 2 is foreign only: kpi-sim/ (untracked) and sibling in-flight TS (stage-hooks.ts, voice/readiness route, ScheduleInterviewPrepPlanDiff.tsx); this card touches no TS. test:perf exit 1 is foreign only: app/page.tsx 1452/1446 and several app/api route graphs over; this card adds no TS module to any graph (Python + JSON + one doc), so its measured share is 0. typecheck's schemas:gen CRLF-only rewrites of the three *.generated.ts restored. python gate: exactly 4 skips (KP_SKIP_BASELINE 4 untouched). loop_open: none - both operator surfaces (the stale-record finding and the --record summary) render once in thresholds.py and all four gated evals pass their units through settle_live; nothing else reads measurements.json.
